releases.title: Quicker to open, a tidier screen, Sara's own installer look

items.text: The Windows installer shows Sara's own picture and colors instead of the stock setup pictures.
Opening or reloading the app is quicker. Your browser now keeps the app's own files.
The notice bar for updates and known issues no longer covers the end of the chat.
On a phone, the top strip no longer takes a row just to repeat the model's name.

releases.title: Sign in with a code anywhere, one home for her messages, no freeze after replies

items.text: One home for what she sends on her own. The morning briefing, check-ins, weekly reviews, the roundup of smaller things and add-on notes arrive in From Sara.
The chat you used last is always at the top. Recent lists your five newest chats from every project, and projects are ordered by last use.
Replies are cheaper and quicker with every model that caches.
Several look-ups in one step run at the same time (pages, searches, files, her memory) instead of one after another.
Her look is made with the picture engine you picked.
A sign-in code from Settings now works on the sign-in page of a new computer.

releases.title: Safer with other people's words, complete backups, quicker with Claude

items.text: Replies with Claude models are faster and cheaper.
The app loads faster away from home. Its files are sent compressed: a first load is about 1.9 MB instead of 6.7 MB.
Words from a web page, an email, search results or a tool server can no longer ride Always allow everything.
She asks before fetching a web address that nobody wrote out while other people's words are in a chat.
Backups take a safe snapshot of every database, not only the main one.

releases.title: Enter sends, stocks on Today, smoother chat, fresh look

items.text: A Stocks tile on Today with charts, and trackers you add right there.
Enter sends your message and Shift+Enter starts a new line, everywhere you type to her.
The page no longer freezes while she writes a long reply in a long chat.
Asking her for something long (a full build prompt or document) no longer ends the turn.

releases.title: Sara knows who you're linked with, and names follow renames

items.text: Sara now knows who you are linked with in Messages and who wrote (never what), so "did Hank reach out?" gets a real answer.

releases.title: Language practice, health coach, family screen, local-only proven, carry backups, kid mode, why

items.text: Practice a language out loud, with cards, listening and your words checked as you speak.
A private health coach shows your week and offers one or two small goals, never medical advice.
A Family screen for a kitchen tablet shows the day, chores, meals and shopping, with a kid-safe Talk.
Local-only mode now comes with a test that runs a full day of features and proves nothing leaves the server.
Backups you can carry on a USB drive or send sealed to a friend's Sara, with a printed recovery sheet.
Kid mode v2 sets rules by age band, with time requests you approve from your phone and a parent dashboard.

releases.title: Public records report, Handle it, memory lane, MCP both ways, team workspace

items.text: A public-records report for personal use: she searches free public sources, cites every fact and saves a PDF marked NOT FCRA COMPLIANT on every page.
Handle it on a renewal, a return, a bill, a Maybe cancel suggestion and a Library form.
Memory lane in Your story writes "My year 2026" or a trip story from your own photos, journal and moments, with local models only.
Popular free tool servers in one click: Settings → Skills & tools → Other programs (MCP) lists free, open-source MCP servers.
A team workspace in business mode. A Team tab with team roles (owner, admin, member, guest) and one table of who may do what; guests only read.
Search help. Type a word or a question under Help → Search help, or at the top of the guide, and she finds the answer among every How do I…?, every setting and its tip.

releases.title: One personality, weekly check-in, easier installs, first ten minutes, host a friend

items.text: How Sara comes across (Settings → Sara → Name and personality): one personality for chat, her voice, email drafts and your website receptionist.
Her weekly check-in shows what she did, what failed and what cost money, with three ideas you can accept in one tap.
The first ten minutes: Set up Sara looks at this computer and offers the right way to run her model, then ends with three quick wins.
Host a Sara for a friend (Settings → Household → People on this server).
Every installer checks the machine before it changes anything: disk space, memory, the port, the system and its version, a 64-bit CPU, an earlier install.
When another program already uses her port, Sara now says so with the next step instead of stopping with a long error.
